name: Warpline
author: CLVRKE
summary: Wavetable synth for standalone MPC built on the open-source Vital engine: plays .vital patches (add your own in <drive>/Warpline/Patches), 360 factory patches with genres, search and favourites, a wavetable picker, a generative 16-step arpeggiator, GRAINZ granular FX and a 16-slot mod matrix with random sources.
